places_that_cut_rows: persona_source_reconciler.chip_profile_provider builds the adapter with max_records=500 -> fetch.max_records (outside this task's artifact contract: lifted inside TaiwanOfficialMarketDatasetAdapter.__post_init__ instead)
provider_adapters.execute_provider_owned_adapter records[:max_records] (outside contract, unchanged: never cuts because the adapter itself fails closed above the same 3000 budget)
scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh SOURCE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS <= 500 check and SOURCE_REFRESH_MAX_RECORDS default 100 (runtime MAX_RECORDS_PER_JOB)

changes.full_market_budget: 3 TWSE/TPEx chip profiles: max_records 3000 (profile key full_market=true). configured.py bound 5000 (named PROVIDER_OWNED_ADAPTER_MAX_RECORDS); FinMind keeps its own 1000 per-job guard in the deploy script.
changes.session_date: taiwan_official._stamp_full_market_sessions: provider row date wins; a date-less row gets chip_publication_schedule.resolve_chip_row_session -> latest_published_chip_session(connector, fetch_time). The caller trade_date/run_date (fetch date) is ignored for these profiles; only provider response dates count. Undecidable session raises SourceEvidenceError naming the profile; fetch date is never used.
changes.listing: existing ListingFilter (security_listing) now also applied to these chip rows when present; rows are never invented for symbols the provider did not return.
changes.no_silent_truncation: the adapter raises 'refusing to truncate' when a full-market chip response exceeds max_records.
changes.batching: single run, no cursor: one provider response is ~1310 rows (TWSE margin) / ~1000 (TPEx), budget 3000 holds the whole session in one refresh; batching not needed, over-budget fails closed.
changes.coverage_readback: records carry provider_listed_count; deploy readback calls chip_publication_schedule.evaluate_chip_row_coverage (complete | partial with missing_count | session_mismatch) against receipt.normalized_count and fails the refresh unless complete.
changes.unchanged: six chip publication schedules and TAIFEX schedule values; only chip profile entries/limits changed in connector_definitions.py (no INTRADAY-KBAR-CONNECTOR-20261111 areas touched).

dedupe_writer.note: default PANTHEON_KEYED_DATASETS_WRITE=dual; hosted re-run behaviour (nothing new when unchanged, replace when changed) is the keyed store contract and still needs the coordinator's hosted measurement. tw_institutional_flow official rows are one wide row per symbol (foreign/trust/dealer columns), not three rows per class.

rollback_reader: same metadata keys, same schema_hash (v1), ISO string date; only the date value changes from '' to the session and partitions follow the session date. test_rollback_reader_reads_new_rows.

runtime_budget.caveat: row JSON includes raw_row and is not the columnar size; the columnar per-day bytes and expired-partition deletion must be measured on hosted by the coordinator (acceptance 8/9). Not claimed as passed here.

acceptance 8 columnar size and partition deletion

session_chain_verification.rule: For undated MI_MARGN/TPEx margin rows, margin_previous_balance and short_previous_balance of every symbol present in the payload and in the stored previous session must equal that session's margin_balance and short_balance. Mismatch or missing previous session fails the run naming the profile with matched/mismatched counts; first-ever load only with accept_first_load, recorded in row session_chain evidence.
session_chain_verification.open_gap: The adapter hook is not wired to the hosted record store: that needs provider_adapters.py/persona_source_reconciler.py, outside this contract. Until a lookup is supplied the verification is inactive (rows are stamped by inference as before). Handed to coordinator.
